notes.title: Summer and Feedback Update is Now Available!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone, [/p][p]We hope you’ve been enjoying your underwater escape experience with friends and family so far! [/p][p]To start the week with some good news, we’re excited to roll out our first major “Summer & Feedback Update”, packed with bug fixes, many gameplay improvements, and new feedback systems to optimize your co-op interactions. [/p][p]Over the past weeks, our team has been closely watching players from around the world dive into the escape rooms we’ve designed with passion. Thanks to your streams, feedback, and messages, we've crafted a new patch aimed at enhancing the overall experience, and we can’t wait for you to try it.[/p][p]Plus, to celebrate, [b]the game is 25% off until August 17[/b]![/p][p]Scroll down for all the details included in the “Summer & Feedback Update 1.3.0”[/p][h2]Gameplay Improvements & Update[/h2][p][b]Global[/b][/p][list][*][p]New sound effects added[/p][/*][*][p]Localization updates across various languages[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Main Game[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now invert the Y-axis when playing with a mouse or gamepad[/p][/*][*][p]For Chinese players: the intro QR code now redirects to a website that doesn't require a VPN to access the Companion App[/p][/*][*][p]New feedback has been added when entering a code on a keypad[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Rescue Submarine[/b][/p][list][*][p]Levers: Success feedback added.
